[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Irish Music Magazine (irishmusicmagazine.com): An online magazine with articles, reviews, and interviews on traditional Irish music.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Dance Ireland (danceireland.ie): The national dance agency for Ireland, offering information on traditional dance styles, classes, and events.
